verdict.rationale: Smooth documents integration with Claude Code and generic CLI agents, and offers custom-tools/API hooks that could be wired into agent frameworks, but there is no documented adapter for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI specifically. missing for 10: named/documented adapters for Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and CrewAI; independent confirmation of framework integrations.
